### 🟡 Changes recommended The `selection_strategy` parameter lacks an explicit type annotation required by the project’s style guide.
1 open issue - [Add a type annotation to selection_strategy](https://github.com/microsoft/PyRIT/pull/3878#discussion_r4453697211) · New
What changed in this PR This PR fixes #3869 by enforcing `SelectiveTextConverter`’s text-only output contract in range and word selection modes, matching the existing token-mode behavior. **Changes:** - Reject non-text sub-converter results before inserting them into the output. - Add parametrized regression coverage for both modes with token preservation enabled and disabled. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​unit/​converter/​test_selective_text_converter.py` | Tests rejection of `image_path` results across both modes and preservation settings. | | `pyrit/​converter/​selective_text_converter.py` | Adds output-type validation to word and character-range conversion. |

review_comments.body: Please annotate `selection_strategy`; the project requires an explicit type for every function parameter (`.github/instructions/style-guide.instructions.md:86`).

Added `selection_strategy: TextSelectionStrategy` in 4d0e8573272b, using the shared base type for both selection strategies. All 142 tests in this converter module pass, along with lint, formatting, and typing checks.
